cohort: 611 preterm infants with birth weight <1500 grams admitted to the Department of Neonatology, Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital of Affiliated to Nanjing Medical University, China between January 2019 and December 2022
finding: Higher gestational age was protective against any stage ROP, while twin birth and moderate-to-severe BPD increased the risk; higher birth weight was protective against severe ROP, while male gender increased the risk.
